educational_scope.principle: Productive systems are first-class curriculum content, not optional enrichment.

learner_experience_contract.teacher_relationship: The learner is continuously guided by a teacher voice that explains, encourages, corrects, gives bounded hints, requests retries, recognizes legitimate composition, and advances demonstrated mastery.

measurement_distinction.direct_lexical_coverage: Measures direct command of canonical concepts.
measurement_distinction.practical_communicative_coverage: Measures successful expression using canonical concepts plus authorized productive systems.

phase1_success_definition: A learner can enter the English Phase 1 track and complete it end-to-end.
Every completed stage produces a durable authoritative checkpoint before advancement.
A learner can leave and later resume from the last confirmed durable checkpoint without relying on browser cache.
The track includes direct concept work, productive-system work, composition, applied written scenarios, and unseen transfer.
The system emits structured learner-performance evidence for every instructional attempt.
The final Phase 1 completion receipt is durable and version-bound.
scope_law: No feature enters Phase 1 unless it materially helps teach, measure, checkpoint, or advance the learner.
